suppress.notes: Bundled front-end assets inside org.apache.flink:flink-runtime-web (Flink's web dashboard UI) — not on flink-generic's runtime classpath, not shipped or executed by this library. Fix rides on future Flink upgrades. Reviewed 2026-07-26.

kotlin-stdlib (1.9.25 / 1.7.10) is a transitive test/runtime dependency of the Kafka client stack (kafka-clients 4.2.0). CVE-2026-53914 is a build-cache deserialization issue not reachable in this library's use. Fix rides on a kafka-clients upgrade. Reviewed 2026-07-26; re-check by until date.

protobuf-java (3.25.5 / 4.31.1) transitive from the Kafka client stack. CVE-2026-0994 is a Python json_format DoS; the Java runtime path here is not affected. Fix rides on a kafka-clients upgrade. Reviewed 2026-07-26; re-check by until date.

okio-fakefilesystem 3.2.0 transitive from the Kafka client stack; a test-only fake filesystem. CVE-2023-3635 (GzipSource DoS) is not on this library's runtime path. Fix rides on a kafka-clients upgrade. Reviewed 2026-07-26; re-check by until date.

com.squareup.wire:wire-* 5.2.0, transitive from the Kafka client stack. - CVE-2018-8909: path-traversal in the unrelated Wire Android messaging app, a well-known false match on the coordinate name. - CVE-2026-45799 (HIGH): real DoS in wire's skipGroup(); fixed in wire 6.3.0, which is a major bump held for its own branch (deps/wire-6) because it can break the AWS Glue schema-registry serde compiled against wire 5. Accepted short-term until that lands. Reviewed 2026-08-03; re-check by until date.

flink-avro 2.3.0 transitive from Apache Flink (provided-scope; the cluster supplies it). CVE-2023-37475 is a Go (hamba/avro) OOM, a false match on the "avro" name. Fix rides on a Flink upgrade. Reviewed 2026-07-26; re-check by until date.

org.springframework:spring-* 6.2.19, transitive from spring-boot in the flink-test-example / flink-example harness modules only — spring appears in ZERO library modules (flink-common, flink-jdbc-sink, flink-snapshot, flink-domain). This barrage of CVE-2026-4788x / 5928x / 5931x is the Sept-2026 Spring Framework disclosure: the RCE/SSRF paths require a running Spring MVC web app using XsltView or a "/**" view-render mapping, which this library is not. NO patched Spring release exists yet (6.2.19 / Boot 3.5.16 are the newest on Maven Central), so there is nothing to bump to. Accepted until a fix ships; Dependabot will flag the patched Boot line. Reviewed 2026-09-14; re-check by until date.
